ValidationRule.description: Cannot skip opportunity stages. Applies to Partner opportunities.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (CASE( StageName , "Introduction",1, "Needs Analysis",2, "Benefits Presentation",3, "Committed",4, "Engaged",5, "Closed Won",6, "Closed Lost",6,0)-1 <> CASE(PRIORVALUE(StageName) , "Introduction",1, "Needs Analysis",2, "Benefits Presentation",3, "Committed",4, "Engaged",5, "Closed Won",6, "Closed Lost",6,0)) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Introduction")) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost")) && RecordTypeId ="0121a000000RMUC" && ISCHANGED(StageName)
